scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact cyclic identity \(\sum_i(x_i-\varphi(x_i))=Tk\), the elementary composite bound \(n-\varphi(n)\ge\sqrt n\), and a complete equality analysis. Finite computation is used only for regression and explicit examples.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the one-step map \(F_k(n)=\varphi(n)+k\) only for integers \(k\ge2\). It classifies equality but does not prove that the simultaneous-primality criterion has solutions for every period or infinitely many periods.
title: Sharp period-size bound and extremal structure for shifted Euler cycles
